name: OneLogin
description: OneLogin is an Identity Management provider that supplies a comprehensive set of enterprise-grade identity and access management solutions, including single sign-on (SSO), user provisioning, and multi-factor authentication. The Sumo Logic App for OneLogin provides real-time visibility and analysis of OneLogin user activity through event data, such as user logins, administrative operations, and provisioning.

panels.name: Risk Scores (None, Low, Medium, High)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json "event.risk_score", "event.risk_reasons" as risk_score, risk_reasons
| number(risk_score)
| where risk_score >= 0
| if (risk_score < 5, "No Risk (0-4)", if (risk_score < 26, "Low Risk (5-25)", if (risk_score < 51, "Medium Risk (26-50)", "High Risk (51-100)"))) as RISK
//| risk_score = 0 ? "ZERO RISK" : "NO RISK SCORE" as RISK
//| risk_score < 20 ? "LOW" : RISK as RISK
| fields risk_score, risk_reasons, RISK
| count_frequent RISK

panels.name: Users prompted for MFA during Login
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json field=_raw "event.event_type_id" as event | where event = 5
| json field=_raw "event.risk_score" as risk | where risk > 3
| json field=_raw "event.risk_reasons" as risk_reasons
| json field=_raw "event.user_name" as username
| json field=_raw "event.ipaddr" as IP
| number(risk)
| count by username 
| sort by _count

panels.name: Users whose MFA was suppressed during Login
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json field=_raw "event.event_type_id" as event | where event = 5
| json field=_raw "event.risk_score" as risk
| json field=_raw "event.risk_reasons" as risk_reasons
| json field=_raw "event.user_name" as username
| json field=_raw "event.notes" as notes
| json field=_raw "event.ipaddr" as IP
| where notes matches "*OTP Suppressed*"
| number(event)
| count by username 
// average worker salary, divided by seconds in an 8 hour workday, 20 seconds for non-push MFA * that number (eg. 75K)
| _count * .20 as savings 
| format("$%.2f",savings) as savings  
| sort by _count

panels.name: Users prompted for MFA by Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json field=_raw "event.event_type_id" as event_id
| json field=_raw "event.risk_score" as risk
| json field=_raw "event.risk_reasons" as risk_reasons
| json field=_raw "event.user_name" as username
| json field=_raw "event.ipaddr" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "event.notes" as notes
| where event_id in ("5","8")
| where notes matches "Authentication method: password + OTP."
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip 
| count_distinct(src_ip) as _count by longitude, latitude

panels.name: Users prompted for MFA by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json "event.event_type_id", "event.app_name","event.ipaddr", "event.user_name", "event.actor_user_name", "event.notes" as event_id, app_name, src_ip, user_name, actor_user_name, notes  
| where event_id in ("5","8")
| where notes matches "Authentication method: password + OTP."
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code,country_name from geo://location on ip = src_ip 
| where country_name!="" and !isNull(country_name)
| count by country_name 
| order by _count

panels.name: Users whose MFA was suppressed by Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json field=_raw "event.event_type_id" as event
| json field=_raw "event.risk_score" as risk
| json field=_raw "event.risk_reasons" as risk_reasons
| json field=_raw "event.notes" as notes | where notes matches "*Authentication method: password + OTP Suppressed.*"
| json field=_raw "event.user_name" as username
| json field=_raw "event.ipaddr" as src_ip
| number(risk)
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip 
| count_distinct(src_ip) as _count by longitude, latitude

panels.name: Users with High Risk Logons (Risk > 51)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json "event.event_type_id", "event.app_name","event.ipaddr", "event.user_name", "event.actor_user_name", "event.notes", "event.risk_score", "event.risk_reasons" as event_id, app_name, src_ip, user_name, actor_user_name, notes, risk_score, risk_reasons
| number(risk_score)
| where event_id in ("5","6", "7", "8", "9", "22", "24", "105", "122")
| where risk_score > 51
| fields event_id, user_name, app_name, risk_score, risk_reasons, notes
| count by user_name
| sort by _count

panels.name: Low Trust by Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json field=_raw "event.event_type_id" as event | where event = 5
| json field=_raw "event.risk_score" as risk | where risk > 0

| json field=_raw "event.user_name" as username
| json field=_raw "event.ipaddr" as src_ip

| where risk_reasons matches "*Low trust for session*"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip

panels.name: MFA Request Failure by Location

panels.name: Global Risk Reasons
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OneLogin
| json "event.risk_reasons" as risk_reasons
| where !isEmpty(risk_reasons) 
| parse regex field=risk_reasons "(?<risk>.+) \([0-9]+%\)" multi
| count by risk
| sort by _count
